notes: Oct 17, 3:44 PM Pacific: Adrian emailed Prakash Joshi at Valley Income Tax & Payroll asking him to take on payroll for KMD Group LLC dba KMD Analytical (1–4 employees) and to run a past-due tax and filing review (LA City business tax, LA County unsecured property tax, FTB 568s and LLC tax, EDD, IRS classification), with the KMD filing history 2019–2025 to verify. Copy Adrian Holguin on the follow-up.
